## ASD Essential Eight: Restrict administrative privileges

Tracks privileged account hygiene, separation of administrative and user duties, standing Global Administrator assignments, Microsoft Entra Privileged Identity Management (PIM) activation justification, phishing-resistant MFA on privileged accounts, and endpoint credential protection (Credential Guard, Windows LAPS and HVCI).

**ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model (November 2023) summary:**
- **ML1**: Privileged accounts are prevented from accessing the internet, email and web services; separate accounts are used for administrative tasks.
- **ML2**: Just-in-time elevation (PIM) replaces standing privileged access; inactive privileged accounts disabled after 45 days; Credential Guard and LAPS enabled.
- **ML3**: Privileged activations require justification and approval; Privileged Access Workstations (PAWs), phishing-resistant MFA and hardware-backed memory integrity are enforced.

> **Disclaimer:** Independent community workbook. Not produced, endorsed or supported by ASD, ACSC or Microsoft. Refer to the [ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model](https://www.cyber.gov.au/resources-business-and-government/essential-cyber-security/essential-eight/essential-eight-maturity-model) and [Microsoft Entra PIM documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/id-governance/privileged-identity-management/pim-configure).

content.query:
let privUsers = IdentityInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AssignedRoles) by AccountUPN
| where array_length(AssignedRoles) > 0
| project AccountUPN = tolower(AccountUPN), AssignedRolesStr = tostring(AssignedRoles);
let emailWebSignins = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where ResultType == '0'
| extend UserLower = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner privUsers on $left.UserLower == $right.AccountUPN
| where AppDisplayName has_any ('Office 365', 'Exchange Online', 'Outlook', 'Teams', 'SharePoint', 'OneDrive', 'Microsoft 365')
| summarize Metric = 'Privileged Email/Web Accounts (ML1)', Value = toreal(dcount(UserLower));
let standingGlobalAdmins = privUsers
| where AssignedRolesStr has 'Global Administrator'
| summarize Metric = 'Standing Global Admins (ML2)', Value = toreal(dcount(AccountUPN));
let pimNoJust = AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where Category == 'RoleManagement'
| where OperationName has 'Add member to role completed (PIM activation)'
| extend Reason = tostring(AdditionalDetails)
| where isempty(Reason) or Reason !has 'Justification'
| summarize Metric = 'PIM Activations Missing Justification (ML3)', Value = toreal(count());
let privWeakMfa = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where ResultType == '0'
| extend UserLower = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner privUsers on $left.UserLower == $right.AccountUPN
| where tostring(AuthenticationDetails) !has_any ('FIDO2', 'Windows Hello for Business', 'Certificate-based authentication', 'Passkey')
| summarize Metric = 'Privileged Users Without Phishing-Resistant MFA', Value = toreal(dcount(UserLower));
union emailWebSignins, standingGlobalAdmins, pimNoJust, privWeakMfa
content.title: Restrict administrative privileges KPI summary

content.query:
let privUsers = IdentityInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AssignedRoles) by AccountUPN
| where array_length(AssignedRoles) > 0
| project AccountUPN = tolower(AccountUPN), AssignedRolesStr = tostring(AssignedRoles);
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where ResultType == '0'
| extend UserLower = tolower(UserPrincipalName)
| join kind=inner privUsers on $left.UserLower == $right.AccountUPN
| where AppDisplayName has_any ('Office 365', 'Exchange Online', 'Outlook', 'Teams', 'SharePoint', 'OneDrive', 'Microsoft 365')
| summarize SignInCount = count(), Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 10), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by UserPrincipalName, AssignedRolesStr
| order by SignInCount desc
| take 100
content.title: Privileged accounts accessing email or productivity web apps (E8-RAP-ML1-02)

content.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago({TimeRange})
| where Category == 'RoleManagement'
| where OperationName has_any ('Add member to role', 'PIM activation', 'Add eligible member')
| extend Actor = coalesce(tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName), tostring(InitiatedBy.app.displayName))
| extend TargetUser = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName)
| extend RoleName = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| extend IsPimActivation = OperationName has 'PIM activation'
| extend IsStandingAssignment = OperationName has 'Add member to role' and not(OperationName has 'PIM') and not(OperationName has 'eligible')
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, RoleName, TargetUser, Actor, IsPimActivation, IsStandingAssignment, Result, AdditionalDetails = tostring(AdditionalDetails)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
content.title: Directory role assignments and Entra PIM activations (E8-RAP-ML2-02, E8-RAP-ML3-01)

content.query:
let privUsers = IdentityInfo
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AssignedRoles, AccountEnabled) by AccountUPN
| where array_length(AssignedRoles) > 0
| project AccountUPN = tolower(AccountUPN), AssignedRolesStr = tostring(AssignedRoles), AccountEnabled;
let lastSignins = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| where ResultType == '0'
| summarize LastSignIn = max(TimeGenerated) by AccountUPN = tolower(UserPrincipalName);
privUsers
| join kind=leftouter lastSignins on AccountUPN
| extend DaysInactive = iff(isnull(LastSignIn), 90, datetime_diff('day', now(), LastSignIn))
| where DaysInactive >= 45
| project AccountUPN, AccountEnabled, AssignedRolesStr, LastSignIn, DaysInactive
| order by DaysInactive desc
content.title: Privileged accounts inactive for 45+ days (E8-RAP-ML2-01)

content.query:
DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessment
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ConfigurationId in ('scid-2003', 'scid-2090', 'scid-2091', 'scid-91')
    or ConfigurationSubcategory has_any ('Credential', 'LAPS', 'Memory', 'Local Administrator')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, IsApplicable, IsCompliant, ConfigurationCategory, ConfigurationSubcategory) by DeviceId, DeviceName, ConfigurationId
| where IsApplicable == true
| summarize CompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == true), NonCompliantDevices = dcountif(DeviceId, IsCompliant == false) by ConfigurationId, ConfigurationSubcategory
| extend CompliancePct = round(100.0 * CompliantDevices / max_of(CompliantDevices + NonCompliantDevices, 1), 1)
| order by CompliancePct asc
content.title: Credential Guard, LAPS and Memory Integrity (HVCI) posture (E8-RAP-ML2-03, E8-RAP-ML3-02)
